Subject: Procurement: Renewal and onboarding checklist for Redwood - Acuity Analytics

Hi Logan,

We're ready to move forward on the renewal and onboarding refresh for Redwood. A couple of items for procurement before we can issue a PO:

- Updated SOW reflecting the 24-month term and +30% committed capacity
- Vendor onboarding checklist completed (W9, security attestation, bank details)
- Acuity PO template (we need the exact billing cadence language)

Can you send the checklist and confirm whether the SOW will be routed through DocuSign or the procurement portal? Our timeline: PO issued by end of next week (target 2027-05-28) if we have docs in place.

Attaching: Acuity internal PO requirements sheet (see stub).

Thanks,
Sofia Martinez
Procurement Lead
Acuity Analytics

Quick update and plan:
- Attached is our vendor_onboard_checklist.xlsx (covers W9, bank info, SOC 2 evidence links, and data processing appendix).
- We'll prepare an SOW amendment for the 24-month term and +30% capacity; Karthik will review contract language for the billing cadence you mention.
- We plan to send the final SOW via DocuSign and will also upload the evidence bundle to your procurement portal (per the link you shared).

Action items / owners:
- Logan: assemble evidence and upload to Acuity procurement portal once we have PO template wording (ETA: 2027-05-24)
- Karthik: review SOW language (billing cadence & DPA clause) and attach recommended edits (ETA: 2027-05-21 EOD)
- Marissa: confirm pricing and discount ladder to reflect committed capacity uplift (ETA: 2027-05-22)

Attaching: vendor_onboard_checklist.xlsx (attachment stub).

Looping in legal review notes inline.

- Agreed on 24-month term but request to ensure the SOW includes explicit termination-for-convenience notice (60 days) and reference to the DPA we have published.
- For billing cadence: prefer language that ties invoices to calendar months rather than usage spikes; if Acuity requires quarterly invoicing we can accommodate but need that in the PO.

I've attached redwood_sow_v2.pdf with tracked suggestions (minor edits to liability and data processing sections). Once Acuity confirms PO wording, I'll produce a final SOW for signature.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
